nodes.summary: For every IMP command $c$ and all states $s$ and $s'$, if the relational denotation of $c$ relates $s$ to $s'$, then executing $c$ from $s$ terminates in $s'$ according to the big-step semantics.
nodes.title: Denotational executions are big-step executions

nodes.summary: For every IMP command $c$ and all states $s$ and $s'$, if executing $c$ from $s$ terminates in $s'$ according to the big-step semantics, then the relational denotation of $c$ relates $s$ to $s'$.
nodes.title: Big-step executions are denotational executions

nodes.summary: The denotation of an IMP command is a binary relation on states, defined by recursion on the command. The command $\mathtt{skip}$ relates $s$ to $s'$ iff $s' = s$. For a variable identifier $x$ and an arithmetic expression $a$, the assignment $x := a$ relates $s$ to $s'$ iff $s'$ is $s$ with $x$ updated to the value of $a$ in $s$. The sequence $c_1; c_2$ relates $s$ to $s'$ iff there is a state $m$ such that $c_1$…
nodes.title: Relational denotational semantics of IMP

nodes.summary: For every IMP command $c$ and all states $s$, $s_1$ and $s_2$, if the relational denotation of $c$ relates $s$ to $s_1$ and $s$ to $s_2$, then $s_1 = s_2$.
nodes.title: The denotational semantics of IMP is deterministic

nodes.summary: For every IMP command $c$ and all states $s$ and $s'$, the relational denotation of $c$ relates $s$ to $s'$ if and only if executing $c$ from $s$ terminates in $s'$ according to the big-step semantics.
nodes.title: Agreement of the denotational and big-step semantics of IMP

nodes.summary: Let $b$ be a Boolean expression and $c$ an IMP command, let $W$ be the relational denotation of $\mathtt{while}\ b\ \mathtt{do}\ c$, and let $\Phi$ be the one-step unfolding functional of a while loop with guard $b$ and body relation the denotation of $c$. Then $W = \Phi(W)$.
nodes.title: The while denotation is a fixed point

nodes.summary: Let $b$ be a Boolean expression, $B$ a binary relation on states, and $\Phi$ the one-step unfolding functional of a while loop with guard $b$ and body relation $B$. Then $\Phi$ is monotone for inclusion of relations: for all relations $R_1$ and $R_2$ on states with $R_1 \subseteq R_2$, we have $\Phi(R_1) \subseteq \Phi(R_2)$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the while-loop unfolding functional

nodes.summary: Given a Boolean expression $b$ (the guard) and a binary relation $B$ on states (the body relation), the functional sends a relation $R$ on states to the relation that relates $s$ to $s'$ exactly when either $b$ evaluates to false in $s$ and $s' = s$, or $b$ evaluates to true in $s$ and there is a state $m$ with $B$ relating $s$ to $m$ and $R$ relating $m$ to $s'$.
nodes.title: One-step unfolding functional of a while loop

nodes.summary: For every Boolean expression $b$, IMP command $c$ and states $s$ and $s'$, the relational denotation of $\mathtt{while}\ b\ \mathtt{do}\ c$ relates $s$ to $s'$ if and only if either $b$ evaluates to false in $s$ and $s' = s$, or $b$ evaluates to true in $s$ and there is a state $m$ such that the denotation of $c$ relates $s$ to $m$ and the denotation of the loop relates $m$ to $s'$.
nodes.title: Unfolding equation for the while denotation

nodes.summary: Let $b$ be a Boolean expression, $c$ an IMP command and $P$ a binary relation on states, and let $\Phi$ be the one-step unfolding functional of a while loop with guard $b$ and body relation the denotation of $c$. If $\Phi(P) \subseteq P$, then for all states $s$ and $s'$ related by the relational denotation of $\mathtt{while}\ b\ \mathtt{do}\ c$, $P$ relates $s$ to $s'$.
nodes.title: Park induction for while loops

nodes.summary: For a boolean guard $b$ and a relation $B$ between states (the body denotation), this is the map $\Phi$ on relations between states, ordered by inclusion, where $\Phi(R)$ relates $s$ to $s'$ exactly when either $b$ is false in $s$ and $s' = s$, or $b$ is true in $s$ and there is a state $m$ with $B(s, m)$ and $R(m, s')$. The map $\Phi$ is monotone: $R_1 \subseteq R_2$ implies $\Phi(R_1) \subseteq \Phi(R_2)$.
nodes.title: The while-loop functional as a monotone map

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
